# montecarlo_spark_credentials (Data Source)

Spark credentials are the sign-in Monte Carlo stores for connections to a Spark Thrift server, reached in binary mode by host or in HTTP mode by URL. The password is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `db_name` (String) Database Monte Carlo connects to, such as `default`, for `binary`. Null for `http`.
- `host` (String) Host name of the Thrift server, for `binary`. Null for `http`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `mode` (String) How Monte Carlo reaches the Spark Thrift server. `binary` takes `host`, `port` and `db_name`. `http` takes `url` and `password`.
- `port` (Number) Port of the Thrift server, such as `10000`, for `binary`. Null for `http`.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `url` (String) URL of the Thrift server's HTTP endpoint, for `http`, such as `https://thrift.example.com:10001/cliservice`. Its path is the HTTP path. For a Databricks cluster, use `https://<workspace-host>:443/sql/protocolv1/o/<org-id>/<cluster-id>`, not the `jdbc:` URL. It cannot hold a user, a password, a query or a fragment. Null for `binary`.
- `user` (String) User Monte Carlo signs in as.
